product_overview: Wolfie Delivery is an operations-focused food delivery platform for managing orders, drivers, merchants, support, finance, and platform analytics from a centralized admin experience. It provides real-time visibility into live operations, fleet activity, and key business metrics.
core_goals: Authenticate into the admin platform and access operational controls
Monitor live order, driver, and revenue performance from the dashboard
Manage drivers by searching, filtering, reviewing, and changing active status
Manage merchants by searching, reviewing, and suspending or activating accounts
Review and filter platform orders by status and customer or order identifier
Track and inspect customer support tickets by status and detail view

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Allows an administrator to sign in with email and password and access the dashboard after successful authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the operations dashboard
Navigate to / -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Operations Dashboard
features.description: Provides a live overview of platform activity, including active orders, on-delivery volume, available drivers, revenue, cancellation rate, live orders, and activity feed.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View active orders count -> View on-delivery count -> View available drivers count -> View revenue today -> View cancelled rate -> Review live orders table
Navigate to /dashboard -> Review live orders table -> Open the view all experience for live orders

features.name: Driver Fleet Management
features.description: Lets administrators inspect the driver roster, search and filter by status, view driver reviews, and toggle a driver between active and inactive states.
user_flows: Navigate to /drivers -> View driver list with status indicators -> Filter drivers by status -> Search drivers by name -> Open driver reviews -> Toggle driver active status
Navigate to /drivers -> Search for a driver by name -> View matching driver records -> Open driver reviews for a selected driver

features.name: Merchant Management
features.description: Lets administrators inspect merchant accounts, search by name, view merchant reviews, and suspend or activate a merchant account.
user_flows: Navigate to /merchants -> View merchant list with status indicators -> Search merchants by name -> Open merchant reviews -> Suspend or activate a merchant
Navigate to /merchants -> Search for a merchant by name -> View matching merchant records -> Open merchant reviews for a selected merchant

features.name: Orders Management
features.description: Allows administrators to review the platform’s order list, filter orders by status, and search by order ID or customer name.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/orders -> View order list table -> Filter by order status -> Search by order ID -> Search by customer name
Navigate to /admin/orders -> View order list table -> Filter by order status -> Review matching orders

features.name: Support Tickets
features.description: Enables administrators to review customer support tickets, filter them by status, and open a ticket to inspect its details.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/support -> View support tickets list -> Filter tickets by open status -> Open a ticket to view details
Navigate to /admin/support -> View support tickets list -> Filter tickets by resolved status -> Open a ticket to view details

routes.description: Root redirect to login or dashboard
Operations overview dashboard with active orders, drivers, revenue stats
Live fleet map with real-time driver locations

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Admin authenticates using email and password via the login form on the root page. Successful login sets JWT token in localStorage and redirects to dashboard.
user_interactions: Enter email in the email input field (id="email")
Enter password in the password input field (id="password")
Click the Login / Sign In button to submit
See error message on invalid credentials
On success, dashboard loads with Operations Overview

features.name: Operations Dashboard
features.description: Shows real-time operations overview with active orders, on-delivery count, available drivers, revenue, and cancelled rate. Includes live orders table and activity feed.
user_interactions: Click View all in Live Orders

features.name: Driver Fleet Management
features.description: Admin can view all drivers with their status, rating, and earnings. Can toggle driver active/inactive status and view reviews.
user_interactions: View driver list with status badges
Filter drivers by status (All, Online, Offline)
Click View Reviews button for a driver

features.name: Merchant Management
features.description: Admin can view all restaurants/merchants with their status, commission, and ratings.
user_interactions: View merchant list with status badges
Click View Reviews button for a merchant

features.name: Orders Management
features.description: Admin can view all platform orders with status, amount, customer, driver, and restaurant info.
user_interactions: Search by order ID or customer name

features.name: Support Tickets
features.description: Admin can view and manage support tickets submitted by customers.
user_interactions: Click on a ticket to view details

known_limitations.issue: Socket.io WebSocket connection may fail if backend is cold-starting on Render free tier
known_limitations.impact: Live updates via WebSocket will reconnect automatically but may have initial delay

known_limitations.issue: Dashboard data relies on NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL which must end with /api/v1
known_limitations.impact: Incorrect URL causes CORS errors and 404 responses - fixed by formatApiUrl helper
